text.name: access_text
text.tool_tip: Click the '?' button on the right for detailed explanations on this setting.

combo_box.name: access_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Click the '?' button on the right for detailed explanations on this setting.

button.name: manage_telehub_btn
button.label: Manage telehub...
button.tool_tip: Telehubs are a legacy feature of SL (used back in the early SL days when you could not teleport everywhere you wanted).

spinner.name: agent_limit_spin
spinner.label: Agent limit
spinner.tool_tip: Sets the maximum number of avatars allowed in this region. Performance may vary depending on the number of avatars present in the region.

spinner.name: object_bonus_spin
spinner.label: Object bonus
spinner.tool_tip: Click the '?' button on the right for detailed explanations on this setting.

button.name: object_bonus_help
button.tool_tip: Click for help about object bonus.

check_box.name: allow_land_resell_check
check_box.label: Allow land resell
check_box.tool_tip: Estate owners and managers can always sell any land owned by the estate owner. When this box is checked, buyers can also resell their land in this region.

check_box.name: allow_parcel_changes_check
check_box.label: Allow land join/divide
check_box.tool_tip: Click the '?' button on the right for detailed explanations on this setting.

button.name: parcel_changes_help
button.tool_tip: Click for help about land join/divide permission.

check_box.name: block_terraform_check
check_box.label: Block terraform
check_box.tool_tip: When checked, land owners will not be able to terraform their land regardless of the per-parcel 'Edit terrain' setting.

check_box.name: block_parcel_search_check
check_box.label: Block land show in search
check_box.tool_tip: When checked, blocks parcel owners from listing their parcels in search.

check_box.name: block_fly_check
check_box.label: Block fly
check_box.tool_tip: When checked, flying is disabled everywhere in the region, regardless of the parcel 'Fly' setting.

check_box.name: block_fly_over_check
check_box.label: Block fly over
check_box.tool_tip: Extends access checks upwards to prevent flying over a parcel, regardless of the flying avatar's altitude (the default is to allow flying 50m above the parcel ground).

check_box.name: restrict_pushobject
check_box.label: Restrict pushing
check_box.tool_tip: When checked, sets the full region to restricted permissions for pushing via the llPushObject() LSL function; then Residents may only be pushed by their own scripts or by the parcel's owner's.

check_box.name: allow_damage_check
check_box.label: Allow damage/enable combats
check_box.tool_tip: When checked, this enables the health system across all parcels regardless of their individual settings. When left unchecked, individual parcel owners will still be able to activate the health system on their parcels. If supported by the simulator, this setting also enables the Combat 2 system.

text.name: on_death_text
text.tool_tip: This combo allows to select the teleport destination of an agent when they 'die' (i.e. when their health reaches zero).

combo_box.name: combat_on_death
combo_box.tool_tip: This combo allows to select the teleport destination of an agent when they 'die' (i.e. when their health reaches zero).

spinner.name: combat_damage_limit
spinner.label: Damage limit
spinner.tool_tip: Sets the maximum amount of damage that can be inflicted to an agent.

spinner.name: combat_dps_spin
spinner.label: Damage throttle:
spinner.tool_tip: Sets the maximum amount of damage per second that can be inflicted to an agent.

spinner.name: combat_hps_spin
spinner.label: Healing/second:
spinner.tool_tip: Sets the percentage of heatlh regeneration per second.

spinner.name: combat_invuln_spin
spinner.label: Invulnerability
spinner.tool_tip: Sets the invulnerability time in seconds, after death occurred.
